$comment: BINDING MAP — agent -> human role (OOR/ECR) -> credential card.
Source of truth for AIDs is each agent CARD (generated by vLEIEnh1/generate-agent-cards.js).
This map deliberately does NOT copy AIDs; it points at the card file and records the human
role each agent is pegged to, plus the delegator it is delegated FROM. The identity-client
loader resolves the concrete AID by reading the referenced card at runtime.
Grounding: REFINED-MultiAgent-Design-vLEI.md sec 2/5/6 and REFINED-Project-Structure.md sec 2/5.
STATUS legend: 'active' = card exists and carries vLEI metadata today;
'placeholder' = designed, card not yet generated on Host B (vLEIEnh1).
configBuyerSellerAIAgent1-with-subdelegation.json): the Host B delegation config defines ONE
Jupiter person (Jupiter_Chief_Sales_Officer / OOR) and sub-delegates sub-agents FROM the seller
AGENT (jupiterSellerAgent), NOT from distinct human ECR officers. Only Treasury is configured
today (configAlias 'JupiterTreasuryAgent', scope treasury_operations); ddCredit and fulfillment
are NOT yet present in that config. Therefore: each sub-agent's delegatedFrom='jupiterSellerAgent'
is FACT; the ECR 'role'/'holder' fields are the DESIGN TARGET (the human officer each SHOULD be
pegged to per REFINED §6) and are recorded under 'hostB' as not-yet-realized. No ECR officer
persons exist on Host B yet — do not assume them.
